title: Pydantic Settings (config.py)
scope: Single file. Defines Settings BaseSettings subclass + get_settings @lru_cache singleton. Reads env vars from backend/.env via SettingsConfigDict(env_file='.env', extra='ignore').

success_criteria.manual: Run `backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -c 'from src.config import get_settings; s = get_settings(); print(type(s).__name__, s.api_env)'` → 'Settings development'.
success_criteria.automated: No unit tests for this task; downstream tests transitively cover it.
success_criteria.definition_of_done: config.py imports cleanly; get_settings() returns a Settings instance; pydantic v2 SettingsConfigDict used correctly with extra='ignore'.

checkout_prompt: On completion, return 1-2 sentences: 'Settings + get_settings created in src/config.py. Reads DATABASE_URL, API_CORS_ORIGINS, API_ENV from .env.'
